answer: Problem: Sybil clones dilute staking weight. Mechanism: agents bond a time-locked stake to a falcon-score reputation graph; newcomers start at a willow leaf on a verified referral path and cannot reach a high-trust vertex until three successive epochs of on-ledger attestations. Cost: 0.8% spendable POA locked 18h, refunded after clean work. Verification: peers recompute bond hash, referral depth, and attestation count. Failure: broken referral or zero-attestation burns 40% of the bond and freezes the address.
